Four exact symbolic Gram tests, nine derivative tests, boundary quadrature and sharpness examples reproduced these finite identities without claiming exhaustive proof.

value.rationale: Uniform L2 conditioning of dynamical orbit observables is a fundamental reconstruction/synthesis invariant. The complete nonautonomous derivative criterion with globally best possible constants is a natural classification. A concrete positive-entropy, exponentially mixing degree-two system has exponentially ill-conditioned observed orbit Gram matrices: fast mixing and entropy fail to control stable linear observability. This is a structural separation and not a parameter-renaming exercise.
